mapper.sql: id, role_code, role_name, description, status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT r. FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (role_code, role_name, description, status, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET role_name = #{roleName}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: UPDATE sys_role SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
